sections.body: We use money to buy things. 🪙
Sometimes we don't spend it. We SAVE it in a jar. 🫙
Little by little, the jar fills up. Then we can buy something special! ⭐
Find a jar. Draw a picture of something you'd like to save for and stick it on.
A clear jar lets children SEE savings grow. Small coins, regularly, teach patience better than big amounts once.

quiz.q: What do we use to buy things at a shop? 🛒
hints: What does a grown-up give the shopkeeper?
It can be coins or paper notes.
At a shop, you give something and get your toy. What do you give?
quiz.explain: We use money to buy things! 🪙

quiz.q: Putting coins in a jar for later is called…
hints: You don't spend the coins now.
When we keep a cookie for tomorrow, we save it. Coins in a jar are…?
